messages.content:
Revise the supplied Python navigation module.
Return a JSON object with exactly one field, code, containing the complete
Python module as a string. No Markdown fences, comments or explanations.
The user supplies the original navigation module,
the requirements, plan, logical review and measured four-world benchmark.
The module must have exactly two functions: choose_action followed by
decide_next_move(state). Keep choose_action exactly as supplied.
Preserve the verified seven-rule
policy and all 64 sensor-state decisions; do not change benchmark thresholds
or invent sensors. In decide_next_move, copy the three blocked flags from the
state dictionary to local names. Initialize selected_goal = None, then use
one if/elif chain to select the first clear indicated goal, in this order:
goal_ahead and not front_blocked -> selected_goal = 'AHEAD';
goal_on_left and not left_blocked -> selected_goal = 'LEFT';
goal_on_right and not right_blocked -> selected_goal = 'RIGHT'.
Finish with return choose_action(front_blocked, left_blocked, right_blocked, selected_goal).
The adapter uses selected_goal, not goal_direction. No imports, loops,
annotations, new helper functions or extra fallback logic.
If all measured checks pass, do not pretend that an unseen bug was fixed.
The revision is a behavior-preserving readability change, to be tested again.
